sections.name: Everyday & Soft
sections.description: Wearable looks with gentle definition, muted colors and natural lip tones.

looks.title: Rosewood Kitten Liner
looks.text: fine espresso-brown kitten eyeliner, matte rose-beige eyeshadow, softly separated lashes, satin rosewood lips, and muted pink blush

looks.title: Soft Taupe Veil
looks.text: softly smudged taupe-brown eyeliner, matte oatmeal eyeshadow, satin beige-pink lips, and pale peach blush

looks.title: Peach Haze
looks.text: thin warm-brown eyeliner, soft peach-beige eyeshadow, creamy muted coral lips, and peach blush

looks.title: Dusty Mauve Tightline
looks.text: deep plum-brown tightline, dusty mauve eyeshadow, satin muted berry lips, and cool rose blush

looks.title: Caramel Soft Wing
looks.text: short chocolate-brown winged eyeliner, matte caramel-taupe eyeshadow, cinnamon-nude lips, and warm rose blush

looks.title: Muted Olive Line
looks.text: muted olive eyeliner along the upper lash line, soft beige eyeshadow, satin apricot-rose lips, and subdued coral blush

looks.title: Grey Lilac Smudge
looks.text: softly smudged slate-grey eyeliner, pale grey-lilac eyeshadow, cool pink-mauve lips, and muted rose blush

looks.title: Apricot Satin
looks.text: bronze-brown tightline, satin apricot-beige eyeshadow, peach-rose lips, and apricot blush

looks.title: Pistachio Demi Lashes
looks.text: soft brown tightline, sheer pistachio eyeshadow, medium-length brown false lashes in a tapered demi shape at the outer halves, satin peach-nude lips, and pale apricot blush

looks.title: Cornflower Lash Clusters
looks.text: fine navy eyeliner, washed cornflower-blue eyeshadow, airy black false lashes arranged in spaced clusters across the upper lash lines with extra outer length, and glossy pink-beige lips

looks.title: Honey Auburn Fan
looks.text: cinnamon-brown eyeliner, honey-beige eyeshadow, softly fanned auburn false lashes with light density and medium length, satin warm-rose lips, and muted peach blush

sections.name: Classic & Polished
sections.description: Balanced, precise looks with clean eyeliner, refined eyeshadow and polished lip color.

looks.title: Red Lip Precision
looks.text: precise black winged eyeliner, satin champagne eyeshadow, neatly fanned lashes, classic satin red lips, and soft rose blush

looks.title: Tailored Mocha
looks.text: dark brown eyeliner with a tapered wing, structured matte taupe eyeshadow, polished mocha-rose lips, and neutral rose blush

looks.title: Navy Raspberry
looks.text: crisp navy eyeliner, pearl-grey eyeshadow, satin raspberry-red lips, and cool pink blush

looks.title: Espresso Cut Crease
looks.text: espresso eyeliner, softly sculpted medium-brown cut-crease eyeshadow, full but tidy lashes, satin caramel-nude lips, and muted peach blush

looks.title: Vintage Berry Flick
looks.text: slim black kitten eyeliner, matte shell-pink eyeshadow, satin berry-rose lips, and restrained rose blush

looks.title: Plum Copper Polish
looks.text: precise deep-plum eyeliner, satin copper-taupe eyeshadow, polished plum-nude lips, and muted mauve blush

looks.title: Ivory Fig Fan
looks.text: precise fig-brown eyeliner, matte ivory eyeshadow, evenly fanned dark-brown false lashes with medium density and length, satin fig-rose lips, and soft rose blush

looks.title: Mushroom Doll Lashes
looks.text: charcoal-brown tightline, matte mushroom-beige eyeshadow, rounded black false lashes with separated doll-like spikes and medium length, and satin mauve-nude lips

looks.title: Porcelain Sable Sweep
looks.text: tapered sable eyeliner, porcelain-beige eyeshadow, long dark-brown false lashes swept toward the outer corners with refined density, satin muted-red lips, and neutral rose blush

looks.title: Cashmere Wine Flick
looks.text: precise wine-red kitten eyeliner, matte cashmere-beige eyeshadow, softly fanned brown lashes, satin muted-wine lips, and restrained rose blush

sections.name: Bright Night Out
sections.description: Saturated evening looks with vivid color, controlled placement and balanced lips.

looks.title: Cobalt Coral
looks.text: bold cobalt winged eyeliner, soft bronze eyeshadow, lifted outer lashes, vivid coral-red lips, and coral blush

looks.title: Emerald Ruby
looks.text: saturated emerald eyeliner, smoky olive-gold eyeshadow, satin ruby-red lips, and muted warm rose blush

looks.title: Violet Halo
looks.text: black tightline, saturated violet halo eyeshadow with a bright lavender center, full rounded lashes, and vivid magenta-rose lips

looks.title: Fuchsia Silver Star
looks.text: crisp black winged eyeliner, vivid fuchsia eyeshadow concentrated on the outer lids, glossy berry-pink lips, and a single tiny silver star sticker beside one outer eye

looks.title: Teal Copper
looks.text: sharp teal eyeliner, burnished copper eyeshadow, satin brick-red lips, and warm terracotta blush

looks.title: Electric Lilac
looks.text: saturated violet eyeliner, electric lilac eyeshadow, lengthened lower lashes, glossy orchid-pink lips, and cool rose blush

looks.title: Tangerine Cobalt Fringe
looks.text: sharp cobalt winged eyeliner, vivid tangerine eyeshadow, dense cobalt-blue false lashes in a long outer-fringe shape, satin coral lips, and warm peach blush

looks.title: Lime Plum Voltage
looks.text: deep plum eyeliner, electric lime eyeshadow, long plum false lashes with alternating clustered lengths across the upper lash lines, glossy berry lips, and cool pink blush

looks.title: Indigo Ruby Fringe
looks.text: black tightline, saturated indigo eyeshadow, vivid ruby false lashes with a dense straight fringe and the longest fibers at the centers, and satin cherry-red lips

sections.name: Glitter & Metallic
sections.description: Foiled, shimmering and glittered eyes balanced by deliberate eyeliner and complementary lips.

looks.title: Antique Gold Foil
looks.text: fine black winged eyeliner, antique-gold metallic eyeshadow covering the lids, satin oxblood lips, and muted brick-rose blush

looks.title: Silver Smoke
looks.text: charcoal eyeliner, metallic silver eyeshadow smoked with graphite at the outer corners, satin muted-plum lips, and cool mauve blush

looks.title: Copper Glitter Halo
looks.text: espresso eyeliner, copper glitter eyeshadow centered on the lids and diffused into matte brown, satin terracotta-red lips, and warm peach blush

looks.title: Rose Gold Halo
looks.text: burgundy eyeliner, rose-gold metallic halo eyeshadow, satin dusty-rose lips, and muted rose blush

looks.title: Emerald Foil Gem
looks.text: deep green eyeliner, emerald metallic eyeshadow, satin blackberry-rose lips, and a single tiny clear gem beneath one outer eye

looks.title: Sapphire Tinsel Lashes
looks.text: navy eyeliner, sapphire metallic eyeshadow, long black false lashes with fine silver-tipped fibers concentrated at the outer corners, and satin blackberry lips

looks.title: Opal Violet Spikes
looks.text: violet eyeliner, opal shimmer eyeshadow, sparse violet false lashes with sharp separated spikes and graduated outer length, glossy lilac-pink lips, and cool rose blush

looks.title: Pewter Bronze Fringe
looks.text: bronze-brown eyeliner, pewter glitter eyeshadow, full bronze false lashes with a short dense fringe across the upper lash lines, and satin brick-rose lips

looks.title: Moonstone Chrome Veil
looks.text: graphite eyeliner, moonstone chrome eyeshadow shifting from icy blue to pearl-lilac across the lids, fine black lashes, cool luminous blush, and metallic mauve-nude lips

sections.name: Gothic & Dark
sections.description: Dark, controlled looks built from smoked eyes, elongated liner and deep lip colors.

looks.title: Black Cherry Smoke
looks.text: elongated black eyeliner, matte charcoal eyeshadow deepened to black at the outer corners, dense upper and lower lashes, and matte black-cherry lips

looks.title: Burgundy Gothic Wing
looks.text: sharp black winged eyeliner, deep burgundy eyeshadow, pointed outer lashes, matte crimson lips, and muted wine blush

looks.title: Aubergine Nocturne
looks.text: black tightline, smoky aubergine eyeshadow, satin dark-plum lips, and cool mauve blush

looks.title: Obsidian Taupe
looks.text: precise elongated black eyeliner, matte cool-taupe eyeshadow, sharply defined upper and lower lashes, and matte black lips

looks.title: Smoked Rose Noir
looks.text: smudged black eyeliner, charcoal eyeshadow with a dusty-rose center, wispy pointed lashes, satin oxblood lips, and muted mauve blush

looks.title: Moss Needle Lashes
looks.text: smudged moss-black eyeliner, matte deep-moss eyeshadow, sparse black false lashes with long needle-thin spikes at the outer corners, and matte olive-brown lips

looks.title: Bone Wine Fringe
looks.text: sharp wine eyeliner, matte bone eyeshadow, dense wine-red false lashes with a jagged medium-length fringe across the upper lash lines, matte oxblood lips, and muted wine blush

looks.title: Midnight Lower Clusters
looks.text: black winged eyeliner, midnight-blue smoky eyeshadow, short black false lashes arranged in clusters along the lower lash lines, and matte deep-plum lips

looks.title: Crimson Thorn Halo
looks.text: blackened-crimson halo eyeshadow, sharp black eyeliner branching into fine thorn-like points at the outer corners, sparse spiked upper and lower lashes, matte dark-crimson lips, and muted wine blush

sections.name: Fantasy & Ethereal
sections.description: Mythic face designs, painted symbols and sculptural lashes inspired by celestial, elemental and legendary forms.

looks.title: Moonvine Filigree
looks.text: pearl-sage eyeshadow, ivory tightline, softly defined natural lashes, fine metallic-gold vines curling from the outer eyes across the temples with tiny crescent-shaped leaves, and opalescent nude lips

looks.title: Dragonfire Sigil
looks.text: molten copper-to-crimson eyeshadow, sharp black eyeliner drawn into a dragon-head silhouette at one outer eye, branching ember-red flame patterns sweeping across both temples, smoked natural lashes, and lacquered garnet lips

looks.title: Constellation Veil
looks.text: midnight-indigo eyeshadow diffused into a translucent blue veil across the upper cheeks, fine silver constellation lines and pinprick stars scattered asymmetrically around the eyes, silver inner-corner highlights, softly lengthened lashes, and cool berry lips

looks.title: Angelic Gilded Wings
looks.text: luminous ivory-gold eyeshadow, symmetrical feathered wings painted in white and pale gold from the outer eyes toward the temples, fine champagne eyeliner, delicate natural lashes, a slender gold halo arc above each brow, and pearlescent rose lips

looks.title: Frost Rune Lace
looks.text: icy blue-silver eyeshadow, pale blue eyeliner, white runic glyphs linked by frost-lace filigree around the eyes and over the bridge of the nose, crystal shimmer tears beneath the lower lash lines, fine natural lashes, and muted lilac lips

looks.title: Mermaid Scale Aurora
looks.text: seafoam eyeliner, teal-to-violet aurora eyeshadow, overlapping iridescent scale patterns painted from the temples onto the cheekbones with scattered pearl highlights, softly curled natural lashes, and glossy blue-pink lips

looks.title: Seraphim Feather Fans
looks.text: luminous white-gold eyeshadow, fine metallic-gold eyeliner, oversized white false lashes formed as layered feather fans above and below the eyes with the longest fibers at the outer corners and brushed-gold tips, faint halo rings painted around the eyes, and pearl-nude lips

looks.title: Infernal Flame Lashes
looks.text: black-to-ember smoky eyeshadow, molten-gold eyeliner, oversized red-orange false lashes with long curved fibers arranged like rising flames in dense upper fans and sparse lower sparks, glowing ember dots beneath the eyes, and lacquered black-cherry lips

looks.title: Emerald Dragonwing Lashes
looks.text: blackened emerald eyeshadow, sharp obsidian eyeliner, oversized emerald false lashes shaped like segmented dragon wings with black-veined panels and rigid pointed spines extending past the outer corners, fine gold scales at the temples, and deep forest-green lips

looks.title: Starlight Moth Lashes
looks.text: dusky violet-blue eyeshadow, silver tightline, oversized iridescent false lashes shaped like luna moth wings with broad patterned upper fans and long delicate lower tails, scattered starlight glitter across the temples, and translucent lavender lips

sections.name: Pink Glam
sections.description: Glossy pink statements ranging from polished queen-bee makeup to playful doll-like glamour.

looks.title: Bubblegum Bombshell
looks.text: bubblegum-pink cut-crease eyeshadow, sharp jet-black winged eyeliner, dense flared black false lashes, high doll-pink blush, and dramatically overlined high-shine pale-pink lips

looks.title: Queen Bee Blush
looks.text: matte petal-pink eyeshadow, precise chocolate-brown kitten eyeliner, neatly separated upper lashes, cool rose blush swept high along the cheekbones, and lacquered raspberry-pink lips

looks.title: Frosted Flip-Phone
looks.text: frosted baby-pink eyeshadow with an icy lilac sheen, silver-white inner-corner highlights, thin charcoal eyeliner, spiky Y2K lashes, pale pink blush, and pearly bubblegum lip gloss

looks.title: Rhinestone Cat-Eye
looks.text: sharp hot-pink cat-eye eyeliner over soft nude-pink eyeshadow, lifted black outer-corner lashes, a neat line of three clear rhinestones beneath each outer eye, sculpted pink blush, and glassy nude-pink lips

looks.title: Cherry Gloss Clique
looks.text: softly smoked rosy-mauve eyeliner, satin blush-pink eyeshadow, feathered black lashes, sheer strawberry blush, and plump cherry-pink glossy lips

looks.title: Cotton-Candy Cut Crease
looks.text: pastel-pink cut-crease eyeshadow edged with powder-blue eyeliner, white shimmer across the lids, full rounded lashes, cotton-candy pink blush, and creamy cool-pink lips

looks.title: Dollhouse Pink Halo
looks.text: bright doll-pink halo eyeshadow, white waterline, painted lower doll lashes, oversized rounded black false lashes, circular baby-pink blush, and glossy porcelain-pink lips

looks.title: Flamingo Pink Glow
looks.text: vivid flamingo-pink winged eyeliner, metallic rose-pink eyeshadow blended into narrow bronze outer corners, long flared brown false lashes, saturated hot-pink blush swept over warm bronzed cheeks, and lacquered watermelon-pink lips

looks.title: Prom Queen Sparkle
looks.text: sparkling hot-pink eyeshadow fading into pale rose at the brow bones, crisp fuchsia winged eyeliner, long lifted black false lashes, luminous candy-pink blush, glossy magenta-pink lips, and a single heart-shaped pink crystal beneath one eye

looks.title: Black Bow Pink Wing
looks.text: graphic black-and-pink double-wing eyeliner, pale pink eyeshadow, sharp cat-eye lashes, tiny black bow accents at the outer corners, cool pink blush, and glossy fuchsia lips

looks.title: Cloud Nine White Lashes
looks.text: soft bubblegum-pink halo eyeshadow, crisp white eyeliner, oversized snowy-white false lashes with dense feathered upper fans and fine lower clusters, luminous cool-pink blush, and glossy marshmallow-pink lips

looks.title: Candy Ribbon Lashes
looks.text: glossy candy-pink eyeshadow, deep fuchsia eyeliner, oversized false lashes layered in alternating baby-pink, hot-pink and coral-pink fibers with curled ribbon-like outer tips, bright strawberry blush, and lacquered raspberry-pink lips
